items.name: w6-s82-5
items.prompt: slothadv style, a sheet of twelve separate game props in a 4 by 3 grid, painted in one consistent storybook style, for a deep dim mangrove swamp, dark wet roots, olive greens, misty light. Top row: two existing props, then a mangrove root crusted with pale oysters, then a fiddler crab with one big orange claw. Middle row: a clump of pitcher plants, a spray of pale swamp orchids hanging from a root, a dripping vine with aerial roots hanging down, long green mangrove seed pods. Bottom row: a few shells and snails on the mud, old net floats tied on a frayed rope, a kingfisher perched on a root post, a mudskipper on a lump of mud. Soft cel shading, thin dark ink outline, light from the upper left on every piece, each piece seen exactly from the side for a side-scrolling platform game, every piece separate in its own space with room round it, on one flat plain pure magenta #FF00FF background, no cast shadow, no ground line, no text.
